footnote.target_changed: The text changed while this window was open. Close it and choose where to put the footnote again. What you wrote will still be here.
footnote.not_here: Footnotes can't go inside code, links or carousels. Put the cursor somewhere else in the text and try again.

image_dialog.title: Insert Image
image_dialog.pdf_not_supported: Multi-page documents (PDFs) can't be inserted as images. Choose a single-page object instead.
image_dialog.image_not_found: We couldn't find an image for this object. Choose another object, or type the image's URL in the URL tab.

answer_text_only: Answers are text only — put images, tables, code, footnotes and widgets in a layer panel.
answer_budget_rule: A line holds {{line_chars}} characters, and each paragraph after the first counts {{break_lines}} more lines. An answer fits on the story's card with up to {{max_paragraphs}} paragraphs and {{budget}} lines. Past {{small_type_lines}} lines, the site sets it in smaller type.
answer_over_hard_limit: Too long for the story's card: the published site will cut this answer. An answer may have up to {{max_paragraphs}} paragraphs and {{budget}} lines, counting {{line_chars}} characters to a line and {{break_lines}} lines for each paragraph after the first. Shorten it, or move the detail into a layer panel.

shell.rotate_hint: Turn your phone sideways for more room to edit.

write_failed.capture: The captured position was not saved. Capture it again.
write_failed.object: The object was not changed. Choose it again.
write_failed.page: The page was not saved. Choose it again.

title_card.show_sections_label: Show section list on title card
title_card.show_sections_empty_helper: No section titles yet — add one in the sidebar to populate the list.
title_card.story_id_warning: When you next publish, this story's address changes from /stories/{{old}}/ to /stories/{{new}}/ and its files in your repository are renamed. Links to the old address will stop working.
title_card.story_id_invalid: A story ID can only contain lowercase letters, numbers, hyphens, and underscores.
title_card.story_id_taken: Another story already uses the ID {{id}}. Choose a different ID.
title_card.story_id_reserved: Your site already has a sheet named {{id}}. Choose a different ID.

step.alt_text_placeholder: Describe what is visible in this zoomed view...
step.alt_text_help: Describe what this specific view of your object shows for visitors using screen readers. Good descriptions mention the subject, action, and important details. For example: "Close-up of the river delta showing trade route annotations and settlement markers."

new_step_dialog.title: Same object for the new step?
new_step_dialog.body: The new step starts with {{title}}, at the same page and position as the last step that used it.

section_card.subtitle_text_only: A section subtitle holds text only. Images, tables, code, footnotes and widgets can't go here.

viewer.no_object: No object has been set yet — click here to choose one
viewer.set_object_in_step1: The viewer object in Step 0 is the same as that for Step 1. Set it there.

delete_step.title: Delete step
delete_step.body: Delete step {{number}} ("{{question}}")? This will remove the step and its layers.
delete_step.layer_warning: This step has {{count}} layer(s) that will also be deleted.

kept_draft.message: You typed text here before the shared text loaded, and it was not saved. The field now shows the shared text.
kept_draft.apply: Replace the shared text with mine

media.media_preview_unavailable: Preview not available for this media type
media.google_drive_no_clip: Google Drive does not support clipping

error.not_available_body: It may still be saving. Give it a moment, then try again.
error.generic_body: This story couldn't be opened. Go back to your stories and try again.

panel.title: Title
panel.caption: Caption
panel.fieldGone: The field you were editing is gone. Click where you want to make this change and try again.
panel.olderFramework: Your site uses Telar {{version}}. Until the site is upgraded, carousel images, formulas inside widgets and footnote numbers may look different on the published site from how they look here.
panel.shownAsWritten: This part can't be previewed, so it's shown as written.
panel.previewUnavailable: Formula preview is unavailable. You can still edit formulas as text.

stage.edit_hint_title: Click the title, subtitle or byline to edit it.

guides.frame_text: Every visitor sees what's inside the frame. Capture position saves this view for the step.

guides.stage_text: A visitor with a window shaped like yours sees this whole area.

stage.save_failed: Your change wasn't saved. Try again.
stage.scroll_hint_mobile: Use the arrow buttons to navigate

in_place.recovered_notice: Your last changes here weren't saved, so they're back in the field. Try again to save them, or discard them to go back to the saved text.
in_place.recovered_marker: Your last changes here weren't saved. Open this field to get them back.

step_line.drag_instructions: To move a step, press Space or Enter on its handle. Use the up and down arrow keys to move it, then Space or Enter to drop it, or Escape to cancel.
step_line.cancelled: Move cancelled. “{{title}}” is back at position {{position}} of {{total}}.
